cohort: A total of 225 women were evaluated in a gynecological pain clinic in Germany, comprising 41 patients with chronic pelvic pain syndrome and 184 control patients undergoing routine gynecological screening.
finding: Significant associations with CPPS were observed for prior pelvic surgery, bowel constipation, history of endometriosis, and prior trauma, suggesting two subgroups of CPPS: endometriosis-associated and neurovegetative.
mod_finding: No differences were found in delivery mode between the CPPS group and control group.
